2. **Products Not Loading**: On real devices, if products aren't properly configured in App Store Connect, the purchase flow fails silently
3. **No Error Feedback**: Users don't see any error messages when things go wrong

- Added alert dialog to show errors

- The "Restore Purchases" button now actually works
